name: PRISMA 2020
source: Page MJ, McKenzie JE, Bossuyt PM, Boutron I, Hoffmann TC, Mulrow CD, et al. The PRISMA 2020 statement: an updated guideline for reporting systematic reviews. BMJ. 2021;372:n71. https://www.prisma-statement.org/prisma-2020-checklist | https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8008539/

items.text: State in the title that the report is a systematic review.
Report a structured abstract following the separate 12-item PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts checklist.
Explain why the review is needed in the context of existing evidence.
State clearly the specific review questions or objectives addressed.
Define study inclusion and exclusion criteria and how studies are grouped for synthesis.
List all databases, registers, websites, organizations, and other sources searched with last search dates.
Provide complete search strategies for every database, register, and website, including all filters and limits.
Describe how records and reports were screened, including reviewer count, independence, and automation tools.
Explain how data were extracted, including reviewer count, independence, author contact, and automation tools.
List and define all outcomes sought and how compatible measures, time points, or analyses were selected.
List all other extracted variables, such as participant or intervention features and funding, plus missing-data assumptions.
Describe risk-of-bias assessment methods, including tools used, reviewer count, independence, and automation tools.
State the effect measure used in synthesis or presentation for each outcome.
Explain how study eligibility for each planned synthesis was determined against predefined intervention groups.
Describe data preparation steps for synthesis, including handling missing summary statistics or conversions.
Describe methods used to tabulate or plot individual study results and syntheses.
Explain synthesis methods and rationale, including meta-analysis models, heterogeneity estimation, and software packages.
Describe methods used to investigate causes of heterogeneity, such as subgroup analysis or meta-regression.
Describe sensitivity analyses performed to test the robustness of synthesized findings.
Describe methods used to assess risk of bias from missing results in a synthesis.
Describe methods used to evaluate certainty or confidence in the evidence for each outcome.
Report search and screening counts from records identified to studies included, ideally via a flow diagram.
Cite studies that appeared eligible at full-text screening but were excluded, stating reasons.
Cite every included study and summarize its key characteristics.
Present risk-of-bias assessments for each included study.
Report group summary statistics and effect estimates with precision for each study and outcome.
Briefly summarize study characteristics and risk of bias across studies contributing to each synthesis.
Report all statistical synthesis results, including summary estimate, precision, heterogeneity, and direction of effect.
Present results from all investigations into possible causes of heterogeneity.
Present results from all sensitivity analyses assessing robustness of synthesized results.
Present assessments of risk of bias due to missing results for each evaluated synthesis.
Present certainty or confidence ratings in the body of evidence for each assessed outcome.
Interpret the review findings overall in light of other relevant evidence.
Discuss limitations of the primary evidence included in the review.
Discuss limitations of the review methods and processes used.
Discuss implications of the findings for clinical practice, policy, and future research.
Provide review registration name and number, or state that the review was not registered.
State where the review protocol can be accessed, or note that none was prepared.
Describe and explain any amendments made to the registration or protocol.
Describe financial or non-financial support sources and the role of funders or sponsors.
Disclose any competing interests of the review authors.

items.topic: Availability of data, code and other materials
items.text: State which review materials, extracted data, and analytic code are publicly available and where.
